name: object_tracker_regs
desc: Object detector / measurement: bounding box, count and sums of the object pixels (luma threshold or colour ranges, run widths) in a search window, per frame.

fields.name: POL
fields.desc: luma mode, 1: object darker than THRESH

fields.name: MODE
fields.desc: 0 luma threshold, 1 colour ranges (Y_RANGE, CB_RANGE, CR_RANGE, SAT_MIN)

fields.name: MIN_RUN
fields.desc: shortest run counted when RUN.MIN_W = 0 (0 or 1: every pixel counts)

fields.name: FEAT_A
fields.desc: term A: 0 the luma / colour test, 1 it or the motion feature, 2 it and the motion feature, 3 the motion feature

fields.name: TERM_B
fields.desc: term B on: the edge feature, in runs of RUN_B (its own blob slots)

fields.name: SKIN_LUT
fields.desc: colour mode: the chroma test is the SKIN_LUT table instead of CB_RANGE / CR_RANGE / SAT_MIN (Y_RANGE still applies)

registers.name: WIN_X
registers.desc: search window columns (inclusive, taken at the frame start)

registers.name: COUNT
registers.desc: object pixels in the last frame (0: nothing found)

registers.name: BOX_X
registers.desc: object box columns of the last frame

registers.name: SUM_X
registers.desc: sum of the object pixels' x (centroid = SUM_X / COUNT)

fields.name: FULL_WIN
fields.desc: the window of the frame being measured is the whole frame

fields.name: BLOB_LOST
fields.desc: runs of the last frame not grouped into a blob (every slot taken; saturates at 255)

registers.name: RUN
registers.desc: run widths counted (a horizontal run of object pixels is judged when it ends)

registers.name: Y_RANGE
registers.desc: colour mode: luma Y = (R + 2G + B) / 4 range

registers.name: BLOB_CFG
registers.desc: blob grouping of the counted runs

fields.name: GAP
fields.desc: a run joins a blob within GAP columns of its box

fields.name: GAP_Y
fields.desc: and at most GAP_Y + 1 lines below its last line

fields.name: KEEP
fields.desc: fewest pixels of a blob kept (a closed smaller blob frees its slot; reported only from KEEP pixels)

registers.name: SCRATCH
registers.desc: CPU scratch words (the firmware's tracking state of this detector's objects)

registers.name: RUN_B
registers.desc: term B run widths counted (judged when a run ends, by its whole length)

registers.name: BLOB_X
registers.desc: blob i columns at the end of the last frame (BLOB_N = 0: none)

registers.name: SKIN_LUT
registers.desc: learned skin table (python-prototype/train_skin.py): word i = (Cr - 112) >> 1, bit j = (Cb - 96) >> 1 (Cb 96..159, Cr 112..175); 1 = skin
